method.base_model: region fixed effects plus provided pct_urban, svi_overall, ruca_primary and tribal_pct
method.conditional_p_values: two-sided add-one sign-frequency from the county-cluster bootstrap; BH applied to these 28 conditional residual-screen p-values; a non-estimable exposure receives p=1
method.holdout: 5-fold region-stratified group assignment; entire state|county clusters held out; OOF delta R2 compares baseline controls with same model plus one external layer
limitations: all outcomes are label-free provided-data estimates, not measured organizer scores
county clustering does not remove spatial dependence between neighboring counties
four study regions do not support national generalization
external covariates are not causal effects
the overall-score candidate components may share inputs with provided controls
dataset pages did not state a dataset-specific licence; the separate federal public-domain assessment is subject to third-party exceptions
method.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg across all 28 layer-by-outcome conditional county-bootstrap tests; non-identifiable conditional exposure residuals are assigned p=1
method.primary_effect: region-adjusted partial correlation of each external exposure with frozen proxy scores, with county-cluster percentile CI; descriptive, not causal
method.residual_screen: conditional partial correlation after residualizing both variables on region fixed effects plus provided pct_urban, svi_overall, ruca_primary and tribal_pct; near-duplicates are reported not estimable
method.uncertainty: 1000 county cluster bootstrap draws, resampling counties with replacement within each region; percentile CI
